detail.title: Cylindrical workpiece mechanical gripper with automatic identification function
detail.abstract: The utility model relates to a cylindrical workpiece mechanical gripper with an automatic identification function, which is characterized in that a connecting hole in a connecting support is connected with a robot, and the gripper also comprises at least one driving mechanism, a clamping block, a sensor transmitting module and a sensor receiving module; the left end and/or the right end of the connecting support are/is mechanically connected with at least one driving mechanism, two clamping fingers are arranged on the driving mechanism and are in driving connection with the two clamping fingers, the clamping fingers and the clamping blocks are mechanically connected to realize the movement of the clamping blocks, a sensor transmitting module is installed on one clamping block, a sensor receiving module is installed on the other clamping block, and the positions of the sensor transmitting module and the sensor receiving module correspond to each other to realize the state monitoring of the cylindrical workpiece. The utility model has simple and reasonable structural design, realizes real-time monitoring on the cylindrical workpiece, has good reliability and safety and high production efficiency, and meets various requirements of users.
